sin.name: false-for-nothing
sin.description: A return typed `X|false`: `false` stands in for "nothing" or "failed", and every caller must test for it.
sin.rule: Never return `false` to say nothing was found or something failed — throw a named exception, return an empty value, or return an Option.
sin.suggestion: Throw a named exception for a failure, or return an empty collection or `Option` for a genuine absence.
